purpose: Determine whether three prospective public repository families can support new evaluation-only task design without falsely claiming independence from a new name.
scope: All regular non-symlink textual artifacts in agent/research, excluding this new campaign and binary extensions; metadata inventories distinguished from source/output/task exposure. Source-language dependencies and known historic model prompts require manual followup.
matching: Case-insensitive bounded tokens click/axum/raylib, only candidate discovery; generic click UI verbs are not family evidence.
decision: Any confirmed prior source/task/model-prompt exposure disqualifies a family as fresh. Absence of text match does not certify no training/pretraining or external exposure. No model execution or source reads yet.
evaluation_policy: Freeze exact tasks, sources, references and exclusion registry before local model invocation; related/translated/revised/derived task variants grouped per source family. No training of evaluation-only cases.
